title: vaultLease
responsibility: Advances a Credential Vault browser lease through claim, reconnect, idle, expiry and finish.

inputs.name: issueVaultLease.session
inputs.description: Authenticated session that requested the login; the only session that may claim the lease.

inputs.name: issueVaultLease.leaseMs
inputs.description: Recipe lease length in milliseconds. Defaults to 15 minutes and is clamped between 1 and 60 minutes.

inputs.name: vaultLease.event
inputs.description: Claim, reconnect, activity, disconnect, tick, finish, revoke or shutdown, with its time and, for claim and reconnect, the session.

outputs.name: vaultLeaseLimits
outputs.description: Claim window, default and maximum length, idle timeout, reconnect window and reconnect count.

outputs.name: issueVaultLease
outputs.description: A new lease in the issued phase with its claim deadline and hard expiry.

outputs.name: vaultLease
outputs.description: The next state, whether the event was accepted and, when refused, the reason.
